articles.summary: MALMÖ, Sweden, Feb. 11, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Oatly Group AB (Nasdaq: OTLY), the world’s original and largest oat drink company, has today published its interim condensed consolidated financial statements for the three and twelve months ended December 31, 2025 (the “Year-End 2025 Report”).
articles.title: Publication of Interim Condensed Consolidated Financial Statements for the Three and Twelve Months Ended December 31, 2025
